items.title: Quasi-DM-ness tested through locally quasi-finite covers over test objects
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks

items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a morphism of algebraic stacks is quasi-DM exactly when over every test algebraic space there is a locally quasi-finite cover of the source whose composite to the test object is locally quasi-finite (author lemma at source lines 5085-5101, label lemma-characterize-quasi-DM). The proof (source lines 5103-5132) applies the local quasi-finiteness characterization in both directions, using the covering criterion in between (proof lines 5103-5131). The two applications of the characterization are the substance. H3.
